summary: Cred analyzes BTC and ETH markets with a neutral outlook. BTC is consolidating around 42k after testing 43-47k resistance. Two bullish scenarios exist: momentum above 47k targeting 58k, or pullback to 38-40k weekly support. Macro headwinds including rate hikes, QT, and geopolitical tensions create uncertainty. ETH shows similar consolidation at 3300s with potential long setup if 3k is reclaimed. Cred advises being selective and preserving capital in this difficult trading environment.
